title: Binance says CFO Kaiser Ng is leaving to "pursue a new venture" days after a $6.3B hack, citing a six-month transition plan, and names Justin Yek as CFO (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Binance says CFO Kaiser Ng is leaving to “pursue a new venture” days after a $6.3B hack, citing a six-month transition plan, and names Justin Yek as CFO — Kaiser Ng, the chief financial officer at Binance Holdings Ltd., the world's largest crypto exchange …
